mapper.sql: s.id, s.activity_id, s.student_id, s.building, s.room_no, s.signup_at, s.status, s.reject_reason, s.award, s.score, s.note, s.reviewed_by, s.reviewed_at, s.created_at, s.updated_at, s.deleted, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.real_name, ''), u.nickname, u.username) AS student_name, p.student_no AS student_no, p.class_name AS class_name, a.title AS activity_title, a.status AS activity_status, a.signup_deadline AS signup_deadline, COALESCE(NULLIF(rb.real_name, ''), rb.nickname, rb.username) AS reviewed_by_name

FROM community_activity_signup s INNER JOIN community_activity a ON a.id = s.activity_id AND a.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = s.student_id LEFT JOIN student_profile p ON p.user_id = s.student_id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN users rb ON rb.id = s.reviewed_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_activity_signup (activity_id, student_id, building, room_no, signup_at, status, reject_reason, award, score, note, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{activityId}, #{studentId}, #{building}, #{roomNo}, #{signupAt}, #{status}, #{rejectReason}, #{award}, #{score}, #{note}, #{reviewedBy}, #{reviewedAt}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE s.activity_id = #{activityId} AND s.student_id = #{studentId} AND s.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT
WHERE s.deleted = 0
ORDER BY s.signup_at ASC, s.id ASC

SELECT
WHERE s.deleted = 0
ORDER BY s.signup_at DESC, s.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE community_activity_signup SET status = #{toStatus}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = #{fromStatus}

UPDATE community_activity_signup SET status = #{toStatus}, award = #{award}, score = #{score}, note = #{note}, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = #{fromStatus}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_activity_signup s WHERE s.activity_id = #{activityId} AND s.deleted = 0 AND s.status != 'rejected'
SELECT s.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS total FROM community_activity_signup s WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND s.activity_id = #{activityId} GROUP BY s.status ORDER BY s.status
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_activity_signup s WHERE s.activity_id = #{activityId} AND s.student_id = #{studentId} AND s.deleted = 0 AND s.status IN ('approved', 'attended')
